capacity_oracle_subset.protocol: Small-fleet offline diagnostic. Test every budget-feasible station combination with nonlinear AC using the true continuous injections on five evenly spaced test days. Safe means every bus is in [0.95,1.05]. Counts refer only to these intervals.

protocol: One measured Ausgrid household, lagged and scaled into synthetic nodal PQ series.
Each known load/PV/slack configuration is fit only on the early training window. Live derating and meter outage reuse the nominal fit.

In outage_derating_recovery the half-hour index modulo 336 determines both temporary events. Reports are unavailable in [116,164); the last PCC loses positive Q in [132,204). The original reports and capability return at the end of their respective windows.
Solar and slack stresses were chosen using uncontrolled AC to exercise both export and overvoltage on all four topologies. Conditions are equally weighted stress tests.
All policies receive the same clock, category reports, local capability and fleet budgets. Legacy and adaptive share the complete station action space; equal split has its legacy preset subset.
Metrics use nonlinear AC on the same continuous held-out PQ intervals. Head export uses negative real slack power from branch currents, including losses, before dispatch.

Each case and each half-hour have equal weight. Paired differences are comparator minus adaptive. 95% intervals resample entire days 500 times and retain pairing across all cases. Macro sensitivity intervals sample circular contiguous 7/34-day blocks to allow serial dependence from weather and the 33-day profile lags.
Wall times include context preparation and a local-transport solve per distinct context. Bytes count serialized neighbor messages, excluding sensor uplink and command delivery.

switch_replay.protocol: Three consecutive, prespecified blocks of whole held-out days. Both policies use the adaptive solver and identical inputs except the switch status. Updated selects the pre-calibrated model for the actual grid; frozen always selects the nominal grid model. Both sets of commands are replayed on the actual switched feeder. Steady-state half-hour AC; switch transients and status-detection delay excluded.
